Through: Mr. Yasir Rauf An  the State with M  Vasu Agarwal alo  Ahmed, PS Sangam  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJEEV NARULA  OR % 07.02.2025 1.
The Petitioner is a life convict in FIR No. 859/2004 registered at P.S. Sangam Vihar, Delhi under Sections 302, 201, 34 of Indian Penal Code, 18601 and Section 25 of the Arms Act, 1959.
2. The Petitioner has completed approximately 22 years and 5 months in custody.
The Petitioner was granted parole on 14th November, 2024 for a period of four weeks, which was extended from time to time.
Eventually, the Petitioner has surrendered on 05th February, 2025.
3. The Petitioner states that he urgently needs to be released to look after his newborn child who is suffering from breathing-related issues.
In this regard, the Petitioner has submitted medical records, which have been duly verified on a previous occasion.
